scope: Ten complete English assembly Help values. No other-language or rendering acceptance.

en.help:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.

qaa-Zsye-XV.help:
💾 Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any «↔️ Same width» or «↕️ Same height» adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. «🖼️ Crop image» trims that image; «🧪 Batch crop» applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. «🧪 Reset crop» restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

«↔️ Same width» and «↕️ Same height» give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose «🧪 Pixels», «🧪 Percent», «🧪 Smallest» or «🧪 Largest». «📏 Restore original sizes» removes normalization and keeps crops.

«🧪 Unplace» returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «🧪 Remove» deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. «💾 Save PNG» saves the assembled image directly. «🎨 Edit in Paint» transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «📁 File > ℹ️ About, licences & credits» panel.
